caption:
The climb is where the noise stops. When the grade steepens and the forest presses in, the only thing left is the sound of tires on gravel and your own breathing in the humidity. It is a singular, quiet kind of focus that only happens when you are deep in the mountains, miles from a paved road. You don't ride here to get somewhere fast; you ride to see how much of the landscape you can carry with you.
